text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD GPU queue spike in us-west-2. queue_length=+3200 tokens; avg latency tokens/sec down 60%. Autoscaler attempts failing. Paging oncall.
samir_oncall: on it. joining bridge now -> https://meet.redwood/incident/9512345678
lina_sre: I see the alert in grafana, queue growth started ~5m ago. spike correlated with sudden model-version rollout for a big customer.
samir_oncall: taking initial triage. can someone share autoscaler logs? jess_infra can you grab cluster events? 
jess_infra: pulling events from cluster-gpu-usw2, looks like nodes failed to attach due to IAM PassRole deny on the launch template role. repeating error: "access denied: iam:PassRole" in controller logs.
jess_infra: sample event: ```Warning FailedCreate  pod/xxx failed to create nodegroup: iam:PassRole not authorized for role arn:aws:iam::111111:role/redwood-launchrole``` 
kai_ml: customer workload from tenant alpha ramped a heavy batched embed job. We pushed a model upgrade 2h ago but only noticed traffic spike just now.
samir_oncall: ok hypothesis: traffic surge + new model increased GPU demand -> autoscaler requests new nodegroup -> IAM passrole denied -> scale stuck -> queue grows. Lina, any hints in autoscaler metrics? 
lina_sre: autoscaler shows repeated CreateInstanceGroup calls returning 403. rate-limited by auth error, not API throttle. Also nodegroups configured with taints for gpu=true:NoSchedule which is fine.
support_lead: support is seeing customer-facing errors: intermittent 503s and high latency for embeddings. CS has opened a ticket with affected customers.
product_ops: estimated impacted customers: alpha-prod and beta-replay pipelines. possible SLA hits. keep me posted.
samir_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) short-term: divert critical traffic to dedicated capacity pool for alpha (kai, can you enable?) 2) infra manually create nodegroup with a role that has PassRole permission 3) long-term: rotate launch template roles to include cross-account passrole and add preflight checks.
kai_ml: enabling routing rule to dedicated pool now. pushing feature flag: `route.alpha -> dedicated-gpu-01` (few secs)
incident-bot: routing change applied by samir_oncall via ops-api at 9512345702
samir_oncall: jess, can you try creating a manual nodegroup with corrected instance profile while we keep diverting traffic? if manual create works we can drain queue.
jess_infra: starting manual create. using role arn:aws:iam::111111:role/redwood-launchrole-withpass; command: ```aws eks create-nodegroup --cluster cluster-gpu-usw2 --nodegroup-name emergency-manual-01 --scaling-config minSize=0,maxSize=10,desiredSize=3 --node-role arn:aws:iam::111111:role/redwood-launchrole-withpass --launch-template name=lt-gpu-v3,version=3``` 
jess_infra: create returned OK, nodes booting. kube nodes appearing: ```NODE NAME STATUS ROLES AGE taints gpu-node-1 Ready <none> 00:01 gpu=true:NoSchedule``` 
lina_sre: once nodes ready, we should kick the autoscaler reconciliation and let it attach pods. also patch autoscaler retry policy to avoid immediate abort on passrole errors.
samir_oncall: inbound queue processing rate improving after divert and manual nodes. queue back to +400 tokens, latency trending down. good. 
support_lead: CS notified alpha customers that we are mitigating; ETA for full restoration ~15-30m.
product_ops: note for postmortem: model rollout triggered capacity surge, we should add rollout traffic shaping + preflight capacity check.
kai_ml: quick note: rolling back the model is possible but would be disruptive for alpha. prefer keep routing to dedicated and continue.
jess_infra: manual nodegroup stable. attaching autoscaler permissions now to launchrole and updating launchtemplate version to 4 with correct instance profile.
incident-bot: autoscaler reconciliation succeeded at 9512345728
samir_oncall: confirming pods scheduling onto new nodes. lina, any lingering taint/cordon issues? 
lina_sre: nodes have taint gpu=true:NoSchedule but pods have tolerations; scheduling is happening. queue processing recovered to normal within 11m of mitigation start.
support_lead: CS: partial credit offered to affected tenants; awaiting legal ok.
product_ops: adding action items: - add preflight IAM check in deployment pipeline - alert for autoscaler auth failures - runplaybook to create emergency nodegroup faster - limit model rollout concurrency
samir_oncall: we should also add an automated fallback route to dedicated pools when autoscaler returns auth errors for X attempts.	eam: :thumbsup:
samir_oncall: closing the page when we confirm stable for 30m. monitoring closely.
incident-bot: incident marked "mitigated" by samir_oncall at 9512345745
